text:
alex: Quick preflight check — planning a small patchset + lockfile bump to fix a gitlink mismatch in vendor before the release cutoff. Targeting EOD Friday. Who can own reviews/merges?

maria: I can take the changelog nudge and PR comment sweep. will check template entries for breaking notes.

devin: I'll run a vendor sync and verify submodule pointers. saw one gitlink mismatch on linux/ci blobs.

alex: thanks. devin, can you share the sync steps you plan to run (so we can replicate in CI)?

devin: plan: 1) update submodule refs on patch branch 2) run `make vendor-sync` 3) regenerate lockfile with `tools/lockgen --stabilize` 4) smoke test `./scripts/smoke -e prod`

sam: heads-up — if lockfile changes touch python deps, please run the packaging CI job locally: `./ci/local-run.sh packaging` — we've had flakes there.

jen: tagging @alex @maria — do we want to cherry-pick the patch into release-candidate or do a fast-forward merge into main and then cut the rc?

alex: prefer cherry-pick into rc to keep main clean. will coordinate the canary after merges.

maria: changelog checklist: ensure PR body has: - brief user impact line - config migration notes (if any) - CHANGES entry in root/CHANGELOG.md. I'll drop a PR review after devin pushes.

devin: pushing branch `patch/gitlink-fix-1973` in ~20m. will add a short commit message: "vendor: fix gitlink -> update submodule pointer + regen lockfile"

sam: when you push, please trigger the `staging-canary` job. deploy-bot can do auto-run if you include `[ci run staging-canary]` in the commit body.

devin: note to self: run `git submodule foreach 'git reset --hard && git clean -fdx'` before updating refs to avoid stray changes.

jen: small ask — if you touch any proto deps, ping infra/compat in the PR so they can sanity-check the codegen.

alex: timeline: devin pushes today, reviews by maria + jen tomorrow morning, cherry-pick to rc by Thursday afternoon, final cutoff Friday EOD. If anyone needs to move tasks, shout now. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: I'll post a quick changelog PR checklist comment to standardize entries.

deploy-bot: CI queued for patch/gitlink-fix-1973 — run id 987654. Status: queued.

devin: CI started. will update thread with green/red.

alex: thanks team — small and focused. try to keep diffs minimal to avoid regen churn. :thumbsup:
